messages.content: For the domain 'test4.org', how can I retrieve only the IDs and context attributes of community comments? Use the continuation cursor 'cur456' and my API key 'key123'.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to retrieve only the IDs and context attributes of community comments from the domain 'test4.org', using the continuation cursor 'cur456' and their API key 'key123'.

We need to produce an HTTP request. According to the instructions, we should output a JSON object with keys: method, url, headers, body. We need to use the correct endpoint: /v1/communities/{domain}/comments. Domain is test4.org. Query parameters: fields=comment_id,context. Also include continuation_cursor=cur456. Also include api_key=key123.

Thus the URL will be https://api.snowplowanalytics.com/v1/communities/test4.org/comments?fields=comment_id,context&continuation_cursor=cur456&api_key=key123

Method GET. No body needed. Headers: Content-Type: application/json. Possibly Accept: application/json. But not required. We'll include Content-Type: application/json.

Return JSON object accordingly.
